settings.reportHeader: Fairview County Sheriff's Office — ESD K9 Unit
settings.reportFooter: Training record — maintained per unit policy

sessions.objective: Outdoor area search; buried and surface hides along tree line
sessions.summary: Morning outdoor work before heat. Cooper located both hides including a buried USB at ~4 inches. Strong independent work off-leash.

sessions.objective: Maintenance: room searches with deep-concealment hides; one blank room
sessions.summary: Strong session. Cooper worked methodically through four rooms including one blank. Deep-concealment microSD behind baseboard required a second pass but he committed to a clean final response without assistance.
sessions.nextFocus: More elevated hides above chest height

sessions.objective: Odor recognition refresh: box line with all trained device types
sessions.summary: ORT-style refresher covering phone, SD, microSD, USB, SIM, and hard drive aids. Six for six with clean responses. Short, high-reward session.

sessions.objective: Vehicle searches, warm conditions; introduce undercarriage placement
sessions.summary: Cooper cleared three of four vehicles well. Missed the SIM card in the wheel-well magnet box on the first pass — likely thermals pulling odor under the vehicle. Re-run after a rest break produced a find with light handler support. Logged as remedial follow-up.
sessions.correctiveFollowUp: Repeat undercarriage/wheel-well placements in cooler conditions, then re-test warm

sessions.objective: Cluttered warehouse problem; elevated and floor-level hides among shelving
sessions.summary: High-clutter environment with shelving to 12 ft. Cooper maintained drive throughout a long problem. Elevated SSD at 6 ft found via air scent cone. One false response near a shelf of seized electronics equipment (actual odor source plausible — logged as unconfirmed rather than false).

sessions.objective: Shoreline / dock search; devices near waterline
sessions.summary: First shoreline session this quarter. Cooper worked dock planking confidently. Waterline phone in dry bag found independently; second hide under dock decking required a directed recheck.
sessions.correctiveFollowUp: Schedule monthly shoreline maintenance; work under-deck airflow problems

sessions.objective: Double-blind school scenario: classrooms and library, distractor odors present
sessions.summary: Double-blind evaluation run. Evaluator confirmed 5 of 6 hides located independently. One false response at a cafeteria cabinet that had recently stored electronics (residual odor suspected) — logged and discussed; not corrected as a handler error.
sessions.correctiveFollowUp: Verify aid inventory storage practices to reduce residual-odor contamination

sessions.objective: Parcel line searches; mixed distractors (food wrappers, chargers without storage)
sessions.summary: Parcel work with deliberate distractors. Cooper ignored a phone charger (no storage media) correctly and indicated on all three loaded parcels. One interest-only response on a parcel that had contained a phone the prior day — did not commit, handler moved on. Good discrimination.
sessions.nextFocus: Increase parcel line length; add moving-belt scenario when available
